summary.text: Shabazz is the Green Party nominee for Michigan's 6th District, nominated at the party's April 25, 2026 convention. He has run for Congress as a Green Party candidate in 2020 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Was the Green Party candidate for Michigan's 14th Congressional District in 2020, losing the general election to incumbent Brenda Lawrence (D).
Was the Green Party candidate for Michigan's 6th Congressional District in 2024, losing the general election to incumbent Debbie Dingell (D).
